Gate 7B: Human-Factors Evaluation (Decision Support)

Source: R/gate_07b_human_factors.R
Gate7bHumanFactors.Rd

Explanations can change users' beliefs and decisions in unintended ways. This gate does not "run" a user study; it validates whether explicit human-factors evidence is provided for high-stakes decision/deployment claims and provides a checklist for expected evidence elements.

When Triggered

This gate is triggered when explanations are intended for non-technical end users or other user-facing high-stakes stakeholders. Technical audits that remain within the analyst/researcher workflow usually do not require Gate 7B by default.

Recommended Evaluation Tasks

  • Error detection (identify wrong model outputs)

  • Appropriate reliance / deferral

  • Consistency across cases

  • Robustness to misleading explanations (spurious patterns)
